full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic close-up gathers three costumed figures against a nearly black background. On the left, a stern man looks forward from beneath an elaborate metal helmet with a tall pointed crest and small studs around its band. At the center, a woman in an ornate crown tilts her pale face upward and toward the left, her eyes wide and lips parted. Curled hair frames the crown, and layered necklaces glint against the dark fabric at her chest. A second man fills the right foreground in partial profile, his face and tall decorated headpiece cropped by the edge of the image. He looks in roughly the same upward direction as the woman, though shadow hides much of his eye. Their shoulders press close together, and heavy textured garments merge into the deep base of the frame. The background carries no clear architecture or landscape; the faces and headpieces emerge from darkness as a compact group. Embossed patterns and small raised ornaments catch specks of white light, contrasting with soft gradations across the woman's cheek and the men's lined skin. The camera is close and slightly below the faces, increasing the upward pull of their gazes and the apparent height of the headgear. Strong light from the upper image left illuminates the central face and the left man's helmet while leaving the right foreground figure in heavier shade. Film-like grain and limited gray values keep the image stark without erasing the costume texture. The overall composition crowds three differently lit faces into a tense upward movement, creating a monumental, theatrical monochrome scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白电影近景把三位身着戏服的人物聚在几乎全黑的背景前。左侧一名神情严厉的男子从精繁金属头盔下望向前方，盔上有高尖冠饰，帽带边围有小铆点。中央一位戴华丽冠冕的女子把浅色面孔向左上仰起，眼睛睁大，嘴唇微张。卷发围着冠冕，层叠项链在胸前深色衣料上闪出微光。另一名男子占据右侧前景，呈部分侧面，脸和高而有饰纹的头饰被画边裁切。他大致与女子同向仰望，不过阴影遮住了眼部大部。三人的肩膀紧挨着，厚重有纹理的衣服融入画面下部的深暗。背景没有清楚建筑或风景；面孔和头饰从黑暗中浮出，形成紧凑群像。凸起花纹和小装饰点接住零星白光，与女子面颊和男子有纹理皮肤上的柔和渐变形成对比。摄影机位置很近，略低于面孔，使他们上扬的目光和头饰高度更强。来自画面左上方的强光照亮中央面孔与左侧男子头盔，让右侧前景人物处于更重阴影。胶片般颗粒和有限灰阶使画面冷峻，却没有抹去服饰肌理。整体构图把三张受光不同的脸挤在一起，形成紧张的向上动势和宏大的戏剧性单色场景。
style_prompt_en: The image has a high-contrast cinematic monochrome treatment, with compact illuminated forms clustered inside broad near-black space. Small bright flecks skim raised ornament and rough textures, while wider soft gray planes retain the volume of the focal area. Cropping presses adjacent silhouettes together, and an upward directional rhythm makes the composition feel monumental despite the close scale. Near contours are sharp where metal-like edges catch light; darker fabric-like areas merge into one dense mass. A high side light creates uneven emphasis across the group and lets the farthest forms recede abruptly. Fine grain softens the stark values just enough to keep a film-like surface. The overall effect is severe, crowded, and theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用高反差电影式单色处理，紧凑的受光形体聚在宽阔近黑空间中。细小亮点擦过凸起装饰和粗糙肌理，较宽的柔灰平面则保留焦点区域的体积。裁切把相邻剪影压在一起，向上的方向节奏使近距离构图仍显宏大。金属般边缘受光处的近景轮廓锐利，较暗织物般区域并成浓密块面。高位侧光在整体中产生不均匀强调，使较远形体骤然退入阴影。细颗粒稍微柔化冷峻的深浅，使表面仍像胶片。整体效果严厉、拥挤且富于戏剧性。
theme_en: A high-contrast monochrome dramatic close-up of three crowned figures looking upward
theme_zh: 三名戴冠人物仰望的高反差黑白戏剧近景
name: Sergei Eisenstein
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
